parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range during which you want to query the near real-time monitoring data of the disk. Specify the time in the [ISO 8601](~~25696~~) standard in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description:
The interval at which the near real-time monitoring data is collected. Unit: seconds. Valid values:

*   5
*   60

Default value: 5.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the disk.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range during which you want to query the near real-time monitoring data of the disk. Specify the time in the [ISO 8601](~~25696~~) standard in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the monitoring data. Valid values:

*   basic: baseline performance data.
*   pro: burst performance data, such as burst I/O operations.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ebs describe-disk-monitor-data --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --disk-id d-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --start-time 2022-06-01T03:00:00Z --end-time 2022-06-01T05:00:00Z --period 5 --type basic --region cn-hangzhou
